name: fresh
does: A brand-new player's very first morning, every time, on the newest deploy: a throwaway storage namespace of its own (nothing of this browser's saves read or written; settings, controls and the telephone's identity at their defaults), the boot writing ?fresh=<token> so a reload, sail or night in it carries on; ?fresh=1 again starts another.
decision: Ed, 2026-11-03: "can you make a link that always starts a fresh game with the latest version?"
